def: One of four public pieces of work in this path, each a replication of a published result at small scale plus one honest extension, released as code and a write-up.
The first artifact: Karpathy's autoresearch loop with a Rust runner, extended to log the gap between proxy gain and held-out gain.
The public result that an artifact must reach before the next one starts, such as 100 or more overnight experiments, a gap chart and a short write-up.
A cheap measurement that stands in for the thing you care about, such as a five-minute training score standing in for a long run.
The improvement of a change measured on data or a budget that the research loop never reads.
A comparison method given the same budget and the same number of attempts as the method being claimed better.
